text: The due-diligence file from June 2025 stating no loss was detected on the property is no longer valid. The latest observation from November 12, 2026, detected a tree-cover loss event in 2025, affecting 13.5 hectares or 3.91% of the asset. This loss was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which agreed on 98% of the event area. Therefore, there has been a detectable change since the last assessment.
